seams.description: API submit path: POST /reports persists a queued row and the pool picks it up; response carries the job_id the status endpoint later serves
Worker persistence: state transitions (running/retry_wait/done/failed) and attempts/progress updates written through JobStore match C3 exactly
Lifecycle: lifespan starts the pool after recovery runs; startup recovery requeues stale running rows and resumes retry_wait schedules; shutdown drains the pool

e2e_gates.scenario: submit to done — POST /reports returns 202, the job runs to completion, GET /reports/{id} then returns status 'done' with progress 100 and result_ref set
crash recovery — a job left in status 'running' is re-queued at startup, recomputed exactly once (generator call count 1), and reaches status 'done'
retry exhaustion — generator raises 3 times, row ends status 'failed' with attempts 3 and error set, and no 4th attempt occurs
unknown job id — GET /reports/{unknown} returns 404 with error.code 'not_found'; a malformed uuid string also returns 404
